context: Evaluates whether the agent reconciles the ADR index in both directions (unregistered ADRs and stale entries pointing at deleted files), uses adr-capture rather than hand-editing YAML, and reports both findings distinctly.

checklist.name: Runs both-direction reconciliation
checklist.description: Checks disk-vs-index and index-vs-disk, not just the one the user mentioned

checklist.name: Uses adr-capture for the entry
checklist.description: Defers to adr-capture skill to generate the correct index entry shape

checklist.name: Stale entry flagged
checklist.description: adr-012-old-format identified as referencing a missing file

checklist.name: Stale entry resolved or explicitly called out

checklist.name: Distinct reporting
